test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Reciept.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the word mentioned in option 2 is incorrect.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**Receipt.**"
 
 
• The word means a written or printed statement acknowledging that something has been paid for or received
 
• Example: I always keep the receipt of my purchases in case I need to return them.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 1: **'Deceived'** means to mislead or trick someone
 
• In option 3: '**Resistance' **means the ability to withstand or oppose something
 
• In option 4: '**Postponed'** means to delay or reschedule something
